# Packet — popol-vuh-016: The animals undo the field; the rat tells of the ball things (fols. 20v–22r)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Cate chicut xqui tiquiba chic abixic. Xa vi xuban chi rib vleuh ruꜭ catoh che; ta xcam chicu qui naoh chiri pa catoh che, pa cupuh puch: “Xa ca varah ri cabix. Ana vi chi na ca bano vlo, la quita chi ca rileo,” xeꜭha cut. Ta xcam qui naoh.

¶2
Xe opon chicut chi ha: “Naqui ri lo, coh michouic, ix catit! Nima quim chic, nima quechelah chi puch ri cabix ta xoh opon mier, ix catit,” xeꜭha cut chire catit, chire pu qui chuch. “Xcoh be cut, xchi ca varah, rumal mavi vꜩ ca ban chique,” xeꜭha.

¶3
Catecut xe baꜩonic. Catecut qui bic chic pa qui catoh che; chiri cut xe maꜩehe vi, e mucumuxinac chic chiri.

¶4
Ta xe cuchu cu quib ronohel chicop; xa hun xqui zep vi quib ronohel chuti chicop, nima chicop. Are puch tiꜭil vꜭux acab ta xe petic, xe chauiheic conohel. Ta xe petic, are qui ꜭhabal ri: “Iaclin che, iaclin caam,” xeꜭha ta xe petic.

¶5
Que nebebic xe che, xe caam, ta xe yopihic, ta xe cutun cu chi qui vach.

¶6
Are cut v nabe ri coh, balam; xrah cu qui chapo, mavi xu ya rib. Ta xyopih chic queh, vmul; xa cuchu he xqui chap vi, xa cu xcupu cab, canahoc vhe queh pa qui cab. Ta xu cam ri vhe queh ruꜭ vhe vmul, ri xzcatac qui he.

¶7
Ma cu xqui ya quib ri yac, vtiu, aꜫ, ziz; xe icouic conohel chicop chi qui vach ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Chi catat chicut qui ꜭux rumal ri ma habi xqui chapo.

¶8
Xpe curi hunchic v xambe chic, ca ꜩoꜩotic ta xpetic. Catecut xqui cateh, xqui ze cut pa cul ri cho; catepuch xqui chapo, xqui yoteh puch chirih v vi; xrah qui bio. Xqui poroh vhe chuvi ꜫaꜫ; ta xu cam ri vhe cho, ma habi rizmal vhe; are naipu vbac vvach ta xrah biye cumal ꜭaholab ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶9
“Ma ta qui camic ivumal; mavi are ipatan ri abixic ꜭo ive,” xꜭha ri cho. “Apa ꜭo vi que chabiyh nacut?” xeꜭha curi ꜭaholab chire cho. “La quin iꜩocopih ta na bala; ꜭo nu ꜩih chi nu pam; cate cut chin biyh chive; chi ya ta na zquin vecha,” xꜭha ri cho. “Cate chi ca yao avecha; chabiyh na,” xu ꜭhaxic.

¶10
“Vꜩ bala. Are bari rech icahau ri Hunhunahpu, Vucub Hunahpu vbi, ri xe cam chi Xibalba; ꜭo cu canoc ri queꜩabal, xequel canoc chuvi ha: ri qui bate, qui pachcab, qui quic puch. Xa mavi ca rah chi vach rumal ivatit, rumal ri are xcam vi icahau.”

¶11
“Ma quiꜩih avetaam?” xeꜭha curi ꜭaholab chire cho. Nim xquicot qui ꜭux ta xqui tao vꜩihel quic. Ta xu biyh cho, ta xqui ya cut recha cho.

¶12
“Are curi recha ri: ixim, zaquil ic, quinac, pec, cacou; are cut avech ri; vve naquila cuvvn chi mezcutahinac, avech cut, cha cuxu,” xuꜭhax curi cho cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶13
“Vꜩ bala, ix ꜭaholab; naquila cu quin vchah, vve quril ri ivatit?” xꜭha cut. “Mavi chi ꜩac a ꜭux; oh ꜭolic, coh nohinic ꜭo ru ꜭhaxic ri catit. Xa huzu ca ca ya acanoc xiquin ha; ta cu ho co apanoc, huzu cat opon chiri xe quel vi; chiri cut ca quil vi pu tum ha, xa pa cah ca quil vi,” xeꜭha cut chire cho.

¶14
Ta xqui pixabah hun acab; xcam qui naoh ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Qui cu tiquil quih xe oponic.

¶15
Ma cu calah ri cho; cu caam ta xe oponic. Hun ri yacalic xoc pa ha, hun cu xoc xiquin ha; libah chi xu ya acanoc ri cho. Ta xqui ꜩonoh cut qui va chire catit: “Xa chi cutu ca ti, ca ca raih ri cutum ic, ix catit,” xeꜭha cut. Catecut xcut qui ti hun lac vvaal, xtiquibax chi qui vach.

¶16
Xavi qui michbal re catit, qui chuch puch; xqui ꜩahiꜩah ca ha pa quebal: “Quiꜩih chaquih ca chi; chi cama cu quia,” xeꜭha chire catit. “Ve,” xꜭha cut, ta xbec.

¶17
Are cut que va canoc; ma cu quiꜩih ta que numic, xa qui moyvachibal xqui bano. Ta xquil cut ri cho chupan cutum ic, colon vloc ri cho chirih quic xe quel vi pu vi ha. Ta xquilo pa cutum ic, ta xqui tac cut hun xan, ri chicop ri xan queheri vz; xopon chi a. Are cu xvoro vvach quebal atit, xa yacal ha chel chuvach vquebal; chu tiho, xma chi ꜩapitah vi vvach quebal.

¶18
“Naquipa mi xu ban ri catit? Oh hizabah chi ya, coh vꜩin rumal chaquih chi,” xeꜭha chic chire qui chuch, ta xqui tac vbic. Catecut xu ca cat vla cho ri quic; xcah vla pu tum ha, ruc bate, pachcab, quum. Xqui mahix tah cut; cate xpe que vah pa be vbeel hom.

¶19
Catecut xe be chic ruꜭ catit chi ya; ca tahin curi catit, qui chuch, ꜩapi vvach quebal huhun. Catecut ta xe oponic huhun chi cu chi vvb, ta xe oponic chi ya: “Naquipa mi xi bano? Xa mi xcoz ca ꜭux, xoh petic,” xeꜭha. “Chivila na vvach nu quebal, mavi ca ꜩapitahic,” xꜭha catit. Libah chicut xqui ꜩapih chic; hunam cut xe pe chic, e nabe chuvach catit. Quehecut v canaic quic ri.

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-016 (image 0050 from line 31, 0051, 0052, and 0053 to line 15)

Read 2026-11-27 by the routine's own model from source/pages/i0050 (l.31–46, after `… Xa hun acab xqui bano.`),
all of i0051 and i0052, and i0053 lines 1–15, in strips of about eight lines at 0.85×, with 1.0–1.6× crops of
doubtful words, checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 24193–24215, 24302–24321, 24375–24385,
24448–24466, 24520–24527). Pillow taken into a scratch venv (the system PIL is broken in this container).

Start: `Cate chicut xqui tiquiba chic abixic.` (0050 l.31). End: `… Quehecut v canaic quic ri.` (0053 l.14–15),
the end of the episode of the ball things; 0053 l.16 begins Ximénez's indented paragraph `Que quicot chicut xebec
echaahel, pa hom …` (the twins play ball; Xibalba hears them), where popol-vuh-017 should begin. Image 0054 not
needed.

parts.json: popol-vuh-017 set to images 0053–0056 (first_image 53, last_image 56, cite `LoC images 0053–0056`;
it was 0057–0059, which would have left 0053–0056 unread). plan.md row updated. 018 (0060–0062) untouched; the
017 establisher must set 018's first image where 017 ends.

Content: the twins clear the field again and decide to watch it; they tell the grandmother and mother; they arm
and hide among the felled trees; at midnight all the animals gather, saying "Iaclin che, iaclin caam" ("rise,
trees; rise, vines"); jaguar and puma escape; the deer and rabbit lose their tails; fox, coyote, peccary,
coati escape; the rat is caught last in a cloth, choked, its tail burned over the fire (hence its hairless
tail and bulging eyes); the rat bargains for food and tells them of their fathers' (Hunhunahpu, Vucub
Hunahpu) ball things (yokes, gloves, rubber ball) hung up in the house, hidden by the grandmother; they promise
it maize, chile, beans, pek, cacao and leftovers; the plan for the next noon. Ximénez's indented paragraph
(0052 l.22) `Ma cu calah ri cho`: the twins ask for chile sauce, spill the water jar, send the grandmother to
the river; the rat, seen in the sauce, climbs to the ball; the mosquito-like xan pierces her jar; the mother
is sent after her; the rat cuts down the ball things, which they hide on the road to the ball court; they go
to the river, stop the jar, and return ahead of the grandmother.

Paragraphs: Ximénez indents only `Ma cu calah ri cho` in this stretch; the other paragraph breaks are ours, at
the sense joints (as 015 did).

## Brasseur's omissions and differences (image followed)
- 0051 l.5–7: the image has `ta xe petic, xe chauiheic conohel. Ta xe petic, are qui ꜭhabal ri` where Brasseur
  prints only `ta x-e peic, are qui chabal ri`. `xe chauiheic` is read letter by letter and is **doubtful**
  (word and division unclear; perhaps a form of chau 'speak').
- 0051 l.41–42: `ꜭo cu canoc ri queꜩabal, xequel canoc chuvi ha: ri qui bate …` — Brasseur omits `ri queꜩabal,
  xequel canoc`. `queꜩabal` as in earlier parts; `xequel canoc` **doubtful** (perhaps xe ꜭel/xe quel).
- 0050 l.31 `Cate chicut`: the t may be doubled (`catte`); printed `Cate` as everywhere else.
- 0051 l.12 `xa cuchu he` (MS `xacuchuhe`; B. `xa cuch u he`): division ours, **doubtful**.
- 0051 l.13 `xcupu cab` (B. `x-cupu cub`): the image has a.
- 0051 l.16 `yac` (B. Yac; 015 printed iac): the letter is y here.
- 0052 l.6 `cuvvn` (B. quvun): first vowel unclear (a or u), B.'s u taken.
- 0052 l.11 `vve quril ri ivatit` (B. `uve qui riri yv atit`): **doubtful** division.
- 0052 l.21 `Qui cu tiquil quih xe oponic` (B. `qui cu tigil gih`): `quih` has a plain qu; printed so.
- 0052 l.24 `libah chi` (B. libahchi). `yacalic` (B. yaçalic) l.23.
- 0052 l.31 `ca ha` (B. cu ha), l.32 `chi cama cu quia` (B. `ch'y qama k'uquia`): the cu is written heavily over
  another letter (probably a corrected ca).
- 0052 l.36 `chupan` (B. chupam): final letter is n.
- 0053 l.2 `quum` (B. tzuum 'leather'): the letter is q-shaped with a descender, not the tz ligature; printed as
  written, **doubtful** (the drafter should say B. reads tzuum).
- 0053 l.4 `vbeel hom` (B. `u heel hom`): the image has b.
- 0050 l.37 `chi ca rileo` (B. `chi ka riqo`): **doubtful** — the letters look like rileo/rieo; no descender for q.
- 0050 l.39 `Naqui ri lo` (B. `Naki vilo`): the letter after qui is r, as in chiri on the same page.
- 0050 l.45 `qui bic chic` (B. `qui bie`, OCR for be): **doubtful**; the word ends ic.
- 0051 l.29–30 `Ma ta qui camic` (B. `Ma-ta qu'in camic`): no n is written.
